title: Shard hosted browser smoke tests
summary: Run every browser-backed WebView test on an isolated Windows runner and retain an aggregate protected Python unit-test gate.
reason: Per-process isolation removed most Chromium accumulation failures, but final main attempt 1 failed diagnostics handoff and attempt 2 failed prose-box audit with the same runner-level ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE on different modules. Module-level runner isolation then proved two tests in the diagnostics module can still share exhausted VM network state. Individual-test runner isolation is required without ignoring console errors or widening timeouts.
behavior_before: One Windows job ran 2,900 Python tests, 210 non-browser WebView tests, and 23 browser modules sequentially. Browser processes were fresh, but all shared one VM network stack and intermittent ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE console failures remained.
behavior_after: Core Python/non-browser tests run in one job; each of 29 browser tests runs as a fail-fast-disabled matrix entry on its own Windows runner; a Linux aggregation job preserves the exact required Python unit tests context and fails unless both complete surfaces succeed. Deep Audit uses a distinct aggregate name to avoid ambiguous required contexts.
manual_validation: OBSERVED: final main run 29205257255 attempt 1 failed diagnostics handoff with Chromium ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE after all 2,900 Python and 210 non-browser WebView tests passed.
OBSERVED: first hosted module matrix isolated the remaining failure to the second diagnostics test, which shared a VM only with the module's first browser test and reproduced ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE.
OBSERVED: run 29205257255 attempt 2 failed a different prose-box browser module with the same ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE, proving the issue recurs across clean hosted VMs and is not one product assertion.
PASS: canonical unittest-discovery-to-matrix comparison confirmed all 29 browser test IDs appear exactly once in both Phase 1 and Deep Audit matrices.
PASS: updated release provisioning guardrail tests (7) and complete tooling Python suite (226) validate the additional fully provisioned matrix job in each workflow.
PENDING: hosted Phase 1 and Deep Audit matrix proof.
rollback_plan: Restore sequential browser execution only if an equivalent Windows runner proves its network stack stable across the complete browser suite. Do not replace isolation with retries, skipped modules, ignored console errors, or wider test timeouts.
notes:
The protected context remains Python unit tests and still represents all 3,139 tests. The individual-test browser matrix uses max-parallel 6 to bound runner demand. No test, assertion, timeout, workflow permission, or required check is removed.
